foregroundPolicy: Original delivered PNG bytes copied exactly; no rewrite or color/image edit
shadowPolicy: RGB16 Raw source PNG decoded by Flutter dart:ui, exported as PNG8, losslessly encoded with Pillow WebP, then re-decoded by the same Flutter engine and byte-compared over all rawRgba pixels
decoderPlatform: Local Windows flutter_tester dart:ui engine; not an Android/iOS device claim
limitations: Equality is to the Flutter-decoded 8-bit source PNG. The original 16-bit PNG and exact scene-linear float32 EXR remain external unchanged.
Raw RGB16 source PNG already clips scene-linear values outside 0..1. WebP equality does not restore clipped values or establish HDR/EXR equivalence.
Canvas sRGB multiply is a display approximation, not scene-linear HDR composition.
Native source approval is not automatic visual approval of this derivative presentation. Flutter layout/blending, physical device, release and user approval remain separate.
